recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-47643 unless the work group later revises the broader compatibility policy for normative references to non-normative artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-47643 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking whether adding a reference to a draft resource from normative content would prevent that draft resource from later being renamed or removed. The approved resolution was to append wording that referenced non-normative resources may still be renamed until normative and may sometimes be removed in future FHIR versions.
initial_application: Commit 0497ffa7855726059d80793c2b254ff8989b232b, included in merged PR HL7/fhir#3181, applied the issue by adding the approved wording to source/versions.html.
additional_context: publish.ini lists versions.html for publication, so source/versions.html is in build scope. FHIR-I WGM minutes record the same persuasive 16-0-5 decision. Zulip searches for the issue key and key wording found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active References row already says that where a reference is to a non-normative resource, the referenced resource name may still change until the resource becomes normative and that non-normative resources may in some cases be removed.
